rows.thesis: 2026 Q1-8 China's electronic information manufacturing output grew 15.7% year-over-year.

evidence.quote: 2026年1－8月，我国电子信息制造业生产快速增长，出口持续上行，效益改善态势稳固，投资保持稳步增长，行业整体发展态势良好。 一、生产快速增长 1－8月份，规模以上电子信息制造业增加值同比增长15.7%，增速较去年同期高4.9个百分点。

rows.thesis: Global PV market grew to 74.4 GW in 2016, potentially reaching 75.4 GW with non-reporting countries.

evidence.quote: The global PV market grew significantly, to at least 74 ,4 GW in 2016. With non-reporting countries, this number could grow up to 75,4 GW, compared to 50 GW in 2015 .
